metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: AXIBUI crystallizes in the rhombohedral crystal system with space group R -3. Reported CIF formula moiety: C252 H241 Eu30 N60 O156 S6 6+,6(N1 O3 1-),48(C1 H4 O1),108(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 6 O neighbors; Eu4 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu2 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu3 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu5 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu6 (Eu) has 6 O neighbors; Eu7 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu8 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu9 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu10 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu11 (Eu) has 6 O neighbors; Eu12 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu13 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu14 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu15 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu16 (Eu) has 6 O neighbors; Eu17 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu18 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu19 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu20 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu21 (Eu) has 6 O neighbors; Eu22 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu23 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu24 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu25 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu26 (Eu) has 6 O neighbors; Eu27 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu28 (Eu) has 7 O neighbors; Eu29 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu30 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 48 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.531-4.055 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 93.98-119.43°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Eu30(μ3-OH)24(L2)6(L1)12(NO3)12(H2O)36]·6(NO3)·48CH3OH·108H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 24 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 12 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 36 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
